text: Qualify Pro FIT only if Aimparency will be a young Berlin company
description: Pro FIT early-stage financing is relevant only if Aimparency becomes a newly founded small technology company based in Berlin. Official 2026 terms describe up to €500,000 total early-stage financing; Phase 1 is normally 50% non-repayable grant and 50% loan, capped at €200,000, with a company-age limit normally 12 months. Do not treat this as a pure €50–200k grant and do not adapt a full application before the location decision. If Berlin is chosen, request IBB's free scoping consultation, validate the R&D anchor project and company-age clock, then update meta/applications/inquiry-ibb-pro-fit.md.
